title: Attention Is All You Need
expected_summary: Introduces the Transformer architecture, which replaces recurrence and convolutions with self-attention alone. It became the architectural foundation of modern large language models.
reviewer_note: Foundational paper; a canonical result for queries about Transformer architecture and self-attention.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
expected_summary: Proposes interleaving chain-of-thought reasoning with external tool actions, letting a language model plan, act, and observe results in a loop.
reviewer_note: Foundational paper for the ReAct pattern used by the Hacker News source workflow.

title: [1hr Talk] Intro to Large Language Models
expected_summary: Andrej Karpathy's one-hour survey of how LLMs are trained, how they work, and the emerging security and capability landscape around them.
reviewer_note: Widely cited primer and a strong introduction to large language models.

title: Things we learned about LLMs in 2024
expected_summary: A year-in-review of LLM capability, cost, and multimodal trends across 2024, written as a long-form retrospective.
reviewer_note: Well-regarded yearly retrospective with broad, accurate coverage of the LLM landscape.
